description: Generate a KYC verification link for a customer. The customer must complete verification before they can make transfers.

customerId.description: The customer ID to generate verification link for

rejectUrl.description: URL to redirect to after rejected verification

successUrl.description: URL to redirect to after successful verification

ttlInSecs.description: Time-to-live for the KYC link in seconds (default: 1800)

verificationType.description: Run one verification step instead of the full flow, e.g. 'proof_of_address' when an RFI asks for it

name: get_verification_link
title: Create verification link
